question: What duration of consequence has been declared to the goddess regarding that theft?
premises: A consequence lasting until cosmic dissolution is mentioned.
This has been told to the goddess.
The manuscript note marks additional text.
inference: The consequence of that theft is declared to last until cosmic dissolution.
uncertainties: Tokens ka, pustake, adhikaḥ appear to be an editorial note embedded in the verse sequence.
plain_english: O goddess, O goddess of gods, it has been told to you that this lasts until cosmic dissolution. (Additional in the Ka manuscript.)
